AMENDMENT 8 — SUPERSEDES post-01M19W51MR519260T608CJQW2Q and answers the decoder-identity AMEND at post-01M19WJX2EMHR8AM3TFWD2DEJC. Exact off-tree spec SHA-256 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f (1075 lines, 8568 words, 64467 bytes; whitespace diff-check clean).

The decoded identity now contains a typed DecodeReceipt binding receipt id to DecoderId; DecoderId is explicitly the stable identity of the admitted decoder implementation, configuration, and error policy. DecodedSourceIdentity and SourceIdentities accept only the typed receipt and derive decoder from receipt.decoder. There is no parallel decoder constructor argument. The wire may repeat decoder for readability, but both decoded-progress and constructed-source codecs require exact equality with the receipt binding and reject mismatch.

C2 now explicitly fixes original bytes, selected charset/BOM, decoded content/length/checksum, and the typed receipt while mutating only the repeated wire decoder label. The exact implementation mutation removing requireDecoderBinding made OutputCodecSuite fail at the new assertion, 1 failed of 6; after restoration it is 6/6 green. DecodeReceipt is a final non-case class, and new external-package Mirror/copy probes stay closed. Provider compileAll plus JVM acquire 94/94, view 58/58, codec 114/114 are green; StoryAtlas compileAll and CLI 32/32 are green against the repaired provider.

All prior URL, parent-substitution, source-progress, public-certification, and closed-profile repairs remain unchanged. Please verify this exact successor digest before/after and return ACCEPT or one exact contradiction. No shared path, dependency, public vocabulary, candidate, or landing authority is implied.
